entries.0066dfe843b31c4c: In the energy-related business field, it states that it has sold products with clear installation benefits that are easy to handle to businesses and households through consultative sales, and has achieved higher customer satisfaction and expanded revenue opportunities by cross-selling products and services with further installation benefits to customers who have already enjoyed those benefits. It states that going forward, by expanding its lineup of energy-related products and services and strengthening its consultative proposal capabilities, it aims to expand its customer base, strengthen its revenue base and differentiate itself from other companies, and to work to establish its corporate brand.

entries.7a83398cd9b839a6: This segment sells electricity at retail. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥19,242 million. It supplies electricity procured through the Japan Electric Power Exchange (JEPX) and bilateral transactions with power generators and others to low-voltage and high-voltage electricity consumers, and earns revenue from monthly electricity charges. It also brokers electricity for high-voltage consumers. Consolidated subsidiaries Grems Power Co., Ltd. and GR Consulting Co., Ltd. are in charge.
entries.9d4d6840e0ee320d: Net income attributable to owners of the parent for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥4,896 million, up 7.4% year on year. The prior year figure was ¥4,558 million.
entries.9e669c5416ccd1e1: It is a holding company headquartered in Shinagawa-ku, Tokyo, and it forms a group with four consolidated subsidiaries. Consolidated employees for the fiscal year ended March 2026 numbered 367, and it is listed on the Prime Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
entries.a355e5b839e760c4: This segment sells products and services related to reducing energy costs. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥14,693 million. Its main focus is selling commercial solar power systems, storage batteries and energy-saving equipment, and it also offers electricity basic charge reduction consulting, on-site PPA, and sales of residential solar power systems. In addition, it earns ongoing revenue from operating grid-scale battery storage facilities and from selling electricity generated at solar power plants (renewable energy development business). The company and four consolidated subsidiaries are in charge.
entries.a841fb9855e1e8a6: It is a business model that supports energy cost reduction for businesses and households through the sale of business-use solar power generation systems, storage batteries and energy-saving equipment, the operation of grid-connected storage facilities, and electricity retailing.

entries.f050238166aed12c: From consulting to reduce basic electricity charges with electronic circuit breakers, through the sale of solar power generation systems, storage batteries and energy-saving equipment, to electricity retailing, it handles products and services related to energy cost reduction within one group, and has a structure that leads to additional proposals (cross-selling) to existing customers. In the retail electricity business, it reduces the risk of fluctuations in electricity procurement prices through measures such as applying its own fuel cost adjustment, consolidating into market-price-linked contracts, bilateral transactions with power generators, and the use of derivative transactions.
